messages:
Maria (AE): Hey team — Derek from ApexBank just sent over their SIG and asked for attachments (network diagram, KMS rotation proof, SOC2, pen test). Can we confirm what we can provide by EOD?
Jon (SE): I can package the infra docs + network diagram. Need to redline any customer-identifying screenshots.
Derek (ApexBank): Thanks Maria/Jon. Ideally we get: 1) network diagram with VPC/subnet labels, 2) KMS rotation policy + last rotation timestamp, 3) SOC2 summary (not full report), 4) recent pen test exec summary, 5) config snippet showing TLS enforced. Is that doable?
Priya (Security): We can share SOC2 summary and encryption controls. Pen test exec summary is allowed if vendor permission cleared. KMS rotation proof: we can provide a log extract and a key metadata export.
Maria (AE): @Priya can you confirm format for the KMS export? Derek wants something he can drop into their intake system.
Priya (Security): We usually provide a small JSON manifest + a CSV of rotation timestamps. Example manifest: ```{
  "key_id": "redwood-prod-1",
  "last_rotation": "2026-02-18T03:12:45Z",
  "rotation_policy": "30d",
  "kms_provider": "aws-kms"
}```
Jon (SE): For network diagram I'll attach a sanitized PNG and original draw.io file so they can inspect subnets. Will strip internal hostnames and replace with roles.
Maria (AE): Derek — will sanitized artifacts be acceptable for your vendor risk team or do they require originals?
Derek (ApexBank): Sanitized + source files are fine, as long as CIDR blocks and AZ labels stay. Hostnames can be redacted.
Gloria (Legal): Quick note: any pen test report we share needs a release ack from the vendor (we have a template). Also NDA scope: confirm with Derek if ApexBank has any restrictions on storing shared artifacts.
sig-bot: Automated reminder: create evidence package ticket in JIRA (#SIG-4317) — attachment deadline 2026-03-15.
Jon (SE): Upload plan: 
- network-diagram-drawio.xml (sanitized)
- network-diagram.png (annotated)
- kms-rotation-manifest.json
- kms-rotation.csv
- soc2-summary.pdf
- pen-test-exec-summary.pdf (if vendor cleared)
- manifest.json (packaging manifest)
Maria (AE): Priya / Jon — can we aim to drop everything into a single zip and sling a GDrive link to Derek? I'll include a short README listing what was redacted and why.
Priya (Security): I'll validate the pen test sharing permissions and produce the rotation CSV (format: key_id,last_rotation_iso).
Jon (SE): I'll produce the network files and a short note describing redactions. Example README snippet: "Redactions: hostnames replaced with role-XXXX, internal ticket IDs removed, IP ranges preserved."
Derek (ApexBank): Perfect. One more ask: can you include a sample API call showing TLS-only enforcement? A curl snippet is enough.
Jon (SE): Sure. Example: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/health --tlsv1.2```
Gloria (Legal): Maria please include the vendor release template if pen-test is included. I'll prefill and send to the vendor for signoff.
Maria (AE): Timeline: Jon/Priya to upload to internal drive by 2026-03-15 16:00 PT. I'll bundle and share link to Derek and create JIRA #SIG-4317.
Derek (ApexBank): Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): One more internal step: I'll scrub any IPs that might map to individual customer infra per policy SEC-47. Will note scrubbed items in README.
Jon (SE): Done — prepping files now. Will ping this thread with the GDrive link when ready. :eyes:
Maria (AE): Closing loop: once link posted I'll schedule a 15m walkthrough with Derek to step through the artifacts.
Jon (SE): Link posted: https://drive.google.com/redwood-sig/abc123 (access: ApexBank@apex.com) — added manifest.json and README.
Derek (ApexBank): Got it, downloading now. Can we do the walkthrough at 14:00 PT tomorrow?
Maria (AE): 14:00 PT booked. Invite sent. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
